articles.title: Trump heads to UN as Iran offers conditions for talks, end to war - NewsNation
articles.description: Iran has laid out its terms for ending the war and restarting talks with the U.S. just as Trump prepares for a high-stakes week of diplomacy.
articles.content:
(NewsNation) President Donald Trump heads to the United Nations as Iran outlines conditions for renewed talks and ending the conflict, with Chinese President Xi Jinping’s visit looming.
